title: Representable free finite-group quotient of a scheme affine over its base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $p:X\to S$ an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and $K$ a finite group acting on $X$ by $S$-automorphisms. Write $K_S=\coprod_{k\in K}S$, with multiplication induced by that of $K$, and let $a:K_S\times_SX\to X$ be the action. Assume the action is free, meaning that $j=(a,\operatorname{pr}_2):K_S\times_SX\to X\times_SX$ is a monomorphism: it is injective on morphisms from every test $S$-scheme [def-pc-fibre-product]. There exist an $S$-scheme $Q$ and an invariant morphism $q:X\to Q$ which represents the fppf sheafification [def-pc-fppf-site, def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the orbit presheaf $T\mapsto X(T)/K_S(T)$ on $S$-schemes, where $K_S(T)$ is the group of locally constant maps $|T|\to K$. The map $q$ is finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free] and surjective, and $j$ induces an isomorphism $K_S\times_SX\simeq X\times_QX$. Moreover for every $S'\to S$ the map $q_{S'}:X\times_SS'\to Q\times_SS'$ represents the analogous fppf orbit sheaf for the base-changed action. In particular it is categorical for invariant morphisms to arbitrary $S'$-schemes: each such morphism factors uniquely through $q_{S'}$. No connectedness or etaleness of $X\to S$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 07S7 (spaces-properties-lemma-quotient-scheme), affine case; finite locally free and kernel-pair conclusions from Tag 03BM (groupoids-proposition-finite-flat-equivalence); categorical and base-change properties are the represented orbit-sheaf interpretation of the fppf torsor conclusion.
